title: Archidocs ADR frontmatter (<project>/adr/NNNN-slug.md)

status.description: Where the decision stands. `proposed`: awaiting acceptance in a pull request. `accepted`: in force. `rejected`: turned down, and kept for its reasoning. `deprecated`: no longer in force, with no ADR replacing it. `superseded`: never written by hand; it is derived once an accepted ADR lists this one in `supersedes`.

date.description: The date of the last status change, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

decision-makers.description: Who made the decision: people's names or Team ids. Not checked.

consulted.description: Who was asked for input: people's names or Team ids. Not checked.

informed.description: Who was told of the decision: people's names or Team ids. Not checked.

elements.description: The Elements and Deployment Targets the decision affects, each as an id in this Project or `project:id`.

items.description: An id in this Project, or `project:id` for one in another Project.

views.description: The Saved Views the decision affects, each as an id in this Project or `project:id`.

items.description: An id in this Project, or `project:id` for one in another Project.

supersedes.description: The ADRs this one replaces once it is accepted, each as a four-digit number in this Project or `project:NNNN`. Only an accepted or deprecated ADR can be superseded.

items.description: An ADR number in this Project, or `project:NNNN` for one in another Project.

description: An ADR's frontmatter. The ADR's title is the first `# ` heading of its body, not a field.
